description: "The Village in the Mountains; Conversion of Peter Bayssière; and History of a Bible" is a historical narrative likely crafted during the early 19th century. This text recounts the journey and spiritual awakening of a merchant, M. ----, who encounters the impoverished yet devout villagers living harmoniously in a remote mountainous area.
